metadata.title: Influential factors on mathematical literacy of Turkish students: An educational data mining study using PISA 2015 data.

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study does not use plausible values as the dependent variable is a binary classification of students rather than a PV-based achievement score.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study does not report applying any sampling weights and treats the data as a convenience sample.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study uses data mining methods on individual student data without accounting for school clustering.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study employs 10-fold cross-validation for internal validation, which does not qualify as validation beyond the estimation sample.
